blocks.markdown: The data subject is entitled to: (a) be informed whether personal information is being or has been processed; (b) be furnished the description, purposes, scope and method of processing, recipients, automated access, PIC identity and contact details, storage period, and rights to access, correction and complaint before the Commission, subject to statutory qualifications; (c) reasonable access on demand to contents, sources, recipients' names and addresses, manner of processing, reasons for disclosure, automated decision processes, dates of last access and modification, and the PIC's designation, name and address; (d) dispute inaccuracies and have the PIC correct them immediately unless vexatious or unreasonable — with corrected and retracted information made accessible, simultaneously received by recipients, and previously informed third parties notified on reasonable request; (e) suspend, withdraw or order blocking, removal or destruction on substantial proof the data is incomplete, outdated, false, unlawfully obtained, used for unauthorized purposes, or no longer necessary; and (f) indemnification for damages from inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, false, unlawfully obtained or unauthorizedly used data. Distinguish being informed, access, correction, blocking/removal, and damages.

The lawful heirs and assigns of the data subject may invoke the Section 16 rights after the data subject's death or when the data subject is incapacitated or incapable of exercising them, to the extent specified by the statute.

Where personal information is processed by electronic means in a structured and commonly used format, the data subject may obtain a copy of the data undergoing processing in an electronic or structured format allowing further use. The Commission may specify the electronic format, technical standards, modalities and transfer procedures. Portability is a Section 18 right, separate from the Section 16 list.

Sections 16–18 do not apply where processed data is used only for scientific and statistical research, no activities are carried out and no decisions taken regarding the data subject, the data is held under strict confidentiality, and it is used only for the declared purpose. They also do not apply to processing gathered for investigations into the data subject's criminal, administrative or tax liabilities. The research exemption is conditional on all four elements.

description: Section 16 rights, transmissibility, portability, and non-applicability.
title: Rights of data subjects
